subject.title: [BUG]: Browser tool: `snapshot` returns page content before scroll, ignoring viewport position

question: Should browser snapshot remain a full-page structural read with scroll metadata, or should OpenClaw add or default to a visible-viewport-scoped snapshot after scroll?
rationale: The source-level behavior is clear, but the intended model-facing contract is not documented and changing defaults affects browser automation compatibility across multiple backends.

options.title: Add Explicit Viewport-Aware Mode
options.body: Introduce a viewport-scoped snapshot mode or scroll/viewport metadata first, keep full-tree reads available, and decide the default after live proof.

options.title: Make Viewport The Default
options.body: Change snapshot output to match the current visible viewport after scroll and provide an explicit full-tree escape hatch for existing workflows.

options.title: Document Full-Tree Semantics
options.body: Keep current snapshot behavior and document that viewport evidence requires labeled screenshots, selectors, or a new follow-up feature.

recommendation.title: Add Explicit Viewport-Aware Mode
recommendation.body: Introduce a viewport-scoped snapshot mode or scroll/viewport metadata first, keep full-tree reads available, and decide the default after live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The browser snapshot route, Playwright snapshot helper, CDP helper, docs, and prior snapshot-mode history all point to steipete as the strongest contract-decision owner.
